title: Eco-sustainable magnetic polymer composites using recycled and rare-earth-free hard magnetic fillers
content:

Ayda Ghary Haghighat, Eider Matxinandiarena, Manuela Zubitur, Agurtzane Mugica, Fulvio Bellato, Anna M. Ferretti, Alessandro Ponti, Souad Ammar, Maryam Abdolrahimi, Gaspare Varvaro, Pierfrancesco Maltoni, Dario Cavallo, Alexander Omelyanchik, Alejandro J. Müller, Davide Peddis
Biodegradable polymer matrices, PCL and PBSA were used to fabricate magnetic composites with recycled NdFeB and rare earth-free lab-synthesized ferrite fillers (SrFe12O19 and SrFe12O19–CoFe2O4) across a wide filling range (1–90%).
